title: Dataset Geography: Mapping Language Data to Language Users

bias_targets.methodology: Extracting named entities from NLP datasets, linking them to countries via Wikidata, and comparing the geographic distribution of these entities to the real-world geographic distribution of the language's speaker populations.

Using country-level entity mapping as a proxy to measure how well the content of a dataset culturally represents the diverse populations of its language speakers (e.g., highlighting Western-centric bias in multilingual datasets).

Using linear regression models to analyze the correlation between the geographic distribution of dataset entities and macroeconomic country-level factors such as GDP, GDP per capita, and population size.
